terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.s1Body: PROOF ("the Service") is an AI-powered document conversion service that transforms PDFs, images, audio, and video files into structured tables (CSV, Markdown, Excel, etc.). The Service is provided via a web application and API.
terms.s2Body: The Service is available only to individuals aged 14 or older. Individuals under 14 may not use the Service without parental or legal guardian consent. EU residents must be at least 16 years old (13-16 depending on member state). By registering, you confirm that you meet the applicable age requirement.
terms.s3Body: Users are solely responsible for the copyright, privacy, and other legal rights associated with the files they upload. Uploading content that infringes on others' copyrights or contains unauthorized personal data is strictly prohibited. Users warrant that uploaded content complies with applicable laws.
terms.s4Body: Service usage consumes credits, which can be purchased in USD. Payments are processed in USD via Paddle. Credits are applied to your account immediately after payment. Free daily allowance resets daily, and purchased credits may be refunded according to our refund policy.
terms.s5Body: Unused credits may be fully refunded within 14 days of purchase (EU consumer protection law). Credits that have already been used are non-refundable. Payment errors and duplicate charges are eligible for full refund. Refunds are processed to the original payment method within 7-14 business days. To request a refund, please email admin@proof.teamcat.app.
terms.s6Body: The Company reserves the right to modify or discontinue the Service. Significant changes will be announced in advance. The Company is not liable for damages arising from service discontinuation unless caused by intentional or gross negligence.
terms.s7Body: All intellectual property rights to the Service's software, design, logos, and trademarks belong to the Company. Users may freely use the output generated through the Service, but may not copy, modify, or distribute the Service itself.
terms.s8Body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Korea. Any disputes arising from the Service shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the Seoul Central District Court as the court of first instance.
terms.s9Body: The Company does not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or reliability of conversion results generated through the Service. The Service is provided 'as is', and users are responsible for independently verifying conversion results. The Company is not liable for indirect damages, data loss, or loss of business arising from the use of the Service.
terms.s10Body: The following actions are strictly prohibited: (1) uploading illegal or copyright-infringing content, (2) uploading documents containing personal data of others, (3) spam or automated bulk requests, (4) reverse engineering or API abuse, (5) uploading files containing malware. Violations may result in immediate account suspension.
terms.s11Body: To report copyright infringement, please email admin@proof.teamcat.app with details of the infringed work, its location, and rights holder information. We will take appropriate action upon receipt, and repeat infringers will have their accounts permanently suspended. Counter-notice procedures are handled via the same email.
terms.s12Body: The Company may suspend or terminate user accounts for violations of these Terms, unacceptable use, or legal obligations. Prior notice is generally given before suspension, but immediate action may be taken in cases of urgent legal violation.
terms.contactBody: For questions regarding these Terms, please contact us at:

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Body: We collect your email address, encrypted password, IP address, payment information (processed via Paddle), and usage records (conversion jobs, credit transactions). Uploaded files are automatically deleted within 48 hours after conversion.
privacy.s2Body: Collected information is used for service provision, payment processing, customer support, service improvement, and legal compliance. The legal basis for processing is GDPR Article 6: contract performance, legal obligation, and legitimate interests.
privacy.s3Body: Personal data is deleted immediately upon account deletion. Uploaded source files are automatically deleted within 48 hours after conversion, while conversion results are stored separately. Payment records are retained for 5 years pursuant to the E-Commerce Act. Upon account deletion, personally identifiable information in payment records is anonymized.
privacy.s4Body: We share minimal payment data with Paddle for payment processing, and minimal data (IP address, etc.) with Cloudflare for CDN and security (CAPTCHA). Otherwise, we do not share personal data with third parties without user consent, except as required by law.
privacy.s5Body: We use Supabase (Seoul, self-hosted) for database hosting and file storage, and Cloudflare for CDN and security. These providers comply with applicable data protection laws.
privacy.s6Title: 6. Your Rights (GDPR / CCPA / Korean Privacy Act)
privacy.s6Body: You have the right to access, correct, delete, restrict processing, and export (data portability) your personal data. You may also opt out of marketing communications. These rights can be exercised via the Settings page or by contacting admin@proof.teamcat.app.
privacy.s7Body: This service uses cookies for authentication session maintenance, language preference, and user experience improvement. Essential cookies are required for service operation, and analytics cookies are used only with your consent.
privacy.s8Body: For privacy-related inquiries, please contact admin@proof.teamcat.app. We prioritize data protection and comply with applicable privacy laws.
privacy.s9Body: Personal data is stored on Supabase (Seoul data center), and payment data is processed by Paddle (UK). Paddle provides appropriate safeguards under GDPR.
privacy.s10Body: Personal data is stored on Supabase (Seoul, self-hosted servers), and CDN is provided via Cloudflare (global edge network). Payment data is processed by Paddle (UK). Data transfers between Korea and the EU are conducted under Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC) or appropriate safeguards.
